purpose: Join formal RedSARA/AGE filings, later Ministerio Fiscal email events and prosecution-side responses without collapsing evidential meaning, procedural identity or channel status.
governing_rules: A RedSARA/AGE receipt proves presentation or receipt only to the extent recorded; it does not prove merits, investigation, adoption, agreement or truth.
A sent email is not a formal RedSARA filing unless a corresponding formal receipt is independently identified.
DRAFT items are excluded from sent/received denominators.
SELF_ARCHIVE items are provenance only and are not delivery evidence.
An incoming acknowledgement, decree or institutional response is response-side evidence and must not be counted as a claimant filing.
Duplicates, corrections and controlling-version messages must be linked and must not inflate substantive-event counts.
The same filename is not file identity; byte identity requires a cryptographic hash match.
An archive, acknowledgement or routing act does not itself prove the truth or falsity of the underlying allegations.

source_verifications.organ: Inspección Fiscal de la Fiscalía General del Estado
source_summary: Page 1 is an Inspección Fiscal notification dated 26 August 2026 attaching the decree for E.G. 745/2026.

The decree states that an email entered Inspección Fiscal on 3 August 2026 and reproduces the request for an independent inspection review of post-knowledge conduct by the Fiscalía Provincial de Las Palmas.

The decree characterises the filing as confused and incoherent, cites Article 66.1(c) of Law 39/2015, and states that no concrete irregularity attributable to a particular prosecutor in a particular matter was specified.
The operative part archives E.G. 745/2026 and orders notification to the complainant.
Page 3 states the optional reconsideration and direct contentious-administrative review routes and their stated one-month/two-month periods.
source_verifications.privacy: The native PDF contains personal/contact information and signatures. Public derivatives must keep privacy minimisation and must not expose unnecessary personal identifiers or contact details.
source_verifications.boundary: The decree is an official institutional outcome for this inspection expediente; it does not establish that the underlying allegations are true or false, nor does it establish criminality or misconduct.
